description: Machine-readable ids for platform-manifest implementations (repos or in-monorepo directories that own a Layer 2 platform manifest.json). Distinct from platforms.json, which enumerates device targets (desktop/mobile/web/ios/android) referenced by token names — this registry enumerates concrete implementation projects a manifest's `platform` field may declare (spec/manifest.md#identity-fields). Referencing an id here is a SHOULD, not a MUST: a manifest may declare a `platform` value not yet listed while a new implementation is incubating.
